extracted.intended_audience: city communications staff and municipal public information officers
extracted.subtask_description: A city-level strategic communications plan that sets objectives, messages, strategies, tools, implementation steps, and evaluation measures to communicate municipal programs and policies during a fiscal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objectives, messages, and strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Set out the objectives, messages, and strategies that will be used during Fiscal Year 2009-2010 to communicate the City’s programs and policies to various audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The plan is designed to set out the objectives, messages, and strategies; it should clearly articulate what the communications effort intends to achieve and the core messages to convey.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe approach and objectives for communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes the city's approach and objectives for communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the overall communications approach and how stated objectives (awareness, engagement, access, transparency, credibility) will guide tactics and message development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current situation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include an assessment of the existing communications environment and conditions that inform strategy selection (what's working, gaps, constraints).

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic messages
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define the concise, repeatable messages that communicate the City's programs and policies to various audiences; messages should align with objectives and be tailored to audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tools and tactics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the channels, platforms, and specific tactics (e.g., social media, community engagement events) that will be used to deliver messages and meet objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation plan
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide timelines, responsible parties, sequencing of activities, and operational details needed to execute the chosen tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measures for assessing outcomes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify metrics and evaluation methods to assess whether objectives (awareness, engagement, access, transparency, credibility) are being met; tie measures directly to objectives and tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicate to various audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Communicate the City’s programs and policies to various audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and segment target audiences and tailor messages, channels, and tactics to each audience's needs and preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase awareness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a primary objective of the plan—communications should raise public knowledge of City programs and policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase engagement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a primary objective—communications should encourage two-way interaction and citizen participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide access
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a primary objective—ensure information and services are accessible to intended audiences through chosen channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish transparency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a primary objective—communications should promote openness about City decisions, policies, and processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reinforce credibility
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a primary objective—communications should build trust and reinforce the City's reputation for reliability and competence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topics: Community Engagement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named topic area to be addressed by the plan; implies emphasis on outreach, public participation, and local involvement tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topics: Social Media
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named topic area indicating use of social platforms as part of tools and tactics for message dissemination and engagement.
